system.description:
Witches are mediaries of magical secrets. One may become a witch through the whispers of a familiar or the favor of a being from beyond.


Iconic Witches

• Dr. Facilier, The Princess and the Frog

• Sabrina Spellman, Sabrina the Teenage Witch

• The Morrigan, Celtic mythology

• Yubaba, Spirited Away


Playing Witch

The witch is a debuffer focused on Casting Spells to stack detriments. Stick to the shadows and pile on Statuses through Hex.


Action: Cast

Move: Backline

Starting Pack: Fortune Teller or Mage


Training: Mysticism

features.name: Occultist
features.description:
You gain a Perk with the Trained: Mysticism Prerequisite, and you can Cast Spells using Mysticism.


Spells: You learn 4 Spells. You learn 1 other Spell every 2 Levels hereafter.


Mana: Your Max Mana is equal to (4 × your Level), and the highest amount of Mana you can spend to Cast a Spell is equal to (2 + your Level).

features.name: Hex
features.description: When you affect Enemies with a Spell, you can hex one of the Targets. Doing so causes the effect of the Spell (not the damage) to be continual until you hex a new Target.

features.name: Ritualism
features.description: Once per Shift, you can conduct a 10-minute Ritual as an Action.

features.name: Grudge Bearer
features.description:
The number of Spells you can cause to be continual on the Target with your Hex Feature increases by 1 now and every 4 Levels hereafter.


Further, if you hex a new Target while you have an Enemy hexed, the new Target is affected by the previous Spells.

features.name: Spite
features.description: You have Favor on Cast Checks against Enemies if you are not Casting the Spell to deal damage.

features.name: Widdershins
features.description: You and your Allies ignore the Status Immunities of your hexed Target.
